optimizedContext.value:
# Change Transition

## Rules

### Signature
- `specd change transition <name> <step> [--skip-hooks <phases>] [--format text|json|toon]`
- `specd change transition <name> --next [--skip-hooks <phases>] [--format text|json|toon]`
- `<name>` required. `<step>` required unless `--next`. `--next` mutually exclusive with `<step>`.
- `--skip-hooks`: comma-separated `source.pre|source.post|target.pre|target.post|all`; omit = run all. `all` skips every phase.
- `--format` default `text`.

### `--next` resolution
- Load current state; map forward target then run normal `TransitionChange` (gates, requires, hooks, errors unchanged):
  - `drafting` → `designing`
  - `designing` → `ready`
  - `ready` → `implementing`
  - `spec-approved` → `implementing`
  - `implementing` → `verifying`
  - `verifying` → `done`
  - `done` → `archivable`
- Unavailable (exit 1, stderr `error:`, no synthetic target): `pending-spec-approval`, `pending-signoff`, `archivable`.

### Refresh
- MUST NOT call `RefreshImplementationTracking` or `ImplementationDetector`.
- Pre-transition and repair-guide `GetStatus`: `refreshImplementationTracking: false` (`TransitionChange` owns refresh).
- Invoke `TransitionChange` with default `refreshImplementationTrackingBefore` unless future flag opts out.

### Approval routing
- MUST NOT pass approval flags to `TransitionChange.execute`. Gates from kernel `config.approvals`.
- `LifecycleEngine`: `ready` + `approvals.spec` → `implementing` routes to `pending-spec-approval`; `done` + `approvals.signoff` → `archivable` routes to `pending-signoff`.
- User names logical target; CLI MUST NOT duplicate routing beyond requested/`--next` target.

### Hooks
- Default order: source.post → target.pre → state transition. Both phases fail-fast.
- `--skip-hooks` → `skipHookPhases` on `TransitionChangeInput`. `all` → caller uses `specd change run-hooks`.

### Progress / observability
- Pass `onProgress`. Text: step feedback; structured: preserve progress.
- MUST show hook start, active hook ID+command, recent output while running, liveness without new output, completion — even if transition later fails.
- Text running label MAY exist; MUST NOT be sole liveness signal. Completed hooks MUST stay readable (not fully overwritten).
- `json`/`toon`: NDJSON stdout. Hook events `stream: "hook-progress"`; transition events (`requires-check`, `transitioned`) `stream: "change-transition"`.
- MUST share presentation with `specd change run-hooks` (running labels, output tail, liveness, failed-hook full output).

### Success output
- `text`: final human confirmation on stdout after progress.
- `json`/`toon`: terminal stdout record `stream: "change-transition"`, `event.type: "complete"`, `event.result` = `result`, `name`, `from`, `to`. Same stream as in-flight records, not standalone object.

### Failures
- Hook fail: exit 2, stderr `error:`. No separate post-transition hook warning. Keep visible which hook + prior output.
- Invalid transition: exit 1, stderr `error:`.
- Text repair guide from `GetStatusResult.nextAction` + `GetStatus` blocker codes (`MISSING_ARTIFACT`, `ARTIFACT_DRIFT`, …):
```
error: cannot transition to <step>
! <CODE>: <message>

repair guide:
  target:  <targetStep>
  command: <command>
  reason:  <reason>
```
- `json`/`toon` failure: stdout stream `event.type: "complete"`, `event.result` = `result: "failure"`, `name`, `from`, `to`, `blockers`, `nextAction`.
- `InvalidStateTransitionError` approval/signoff reason MUST appear on stderr (not generic invalid-transition).
- `--next` with no transition-driven next: stderr MUST explain why auto-advance impossible.
- `implementing → verifying` incomplete tasks (`taskCompletionCheck.incompletePattern`): exit 1, stderr names blocking artifact.
- Target `requires` not `complete|skipped`: exit 1, stderr `error:`.

## Constraints
- User specifies logical target; help MUST NOT expose routing.
- Repair-guide blockers/nextAction from TransitionChange failure + GetStatus — CLI MUST NOT recompute.
- Text: progress on stderr; final confirmation stdout.
- json/toon: progress + terminal complete on stdout; stderr for non-structured diagnostics only.
